description: Defines templated classes and functions for creating and managing MKL Sparse BLAS sparse matrix descriptors, specifically CSR and BSR formats, within the at::mkl::sparse namespace.

classes.name: MklSparseDescriptorDeleter
classes.description: A deleter struct for managing the lifetime of MKL sparse descriptors.

classes.name: MklSparseDescriptor
classes.description: A base class template for MKL sparse descriptors managing a raw pointer with custom deleter.

classes.name: MklSparseCsrDescriptor
classes.description: A class for creating and managing MKL CSR (or BSR) sparse matrix descriptors from PyTorch tensors.

methods.name: prepare_indices_for_mkl
methods.description: Prepares index tensors for MKL by ensuring correct scalar type based on MKL ILP64 or LP64 mode.

methods.name: MklSparseCsrDescriptor (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs an MKL CSR/Bsr sparse matrix descriptor from a PyTorch sparse tensor.

methods.name: MklSparseCsrDescriptor (default constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an empty MKL sparse matrix descriptor.
